limitations.description: GIBS PNG is visual evidence only. Numeric rainfall must not be inferred from pixel colors without a separately validated algorithm and calibrated color map.
IMERG is a modelled precipitation estimate, not a direct measurement. Processing delay applies.
USGS gage values are provisional and subject to revision.
A single gage reading does not establish a universal flood threshold or a property-level flood conclusion.
